NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ❌ | Remove "Fixes a part of .." from all commits: commit messages are unchanged since the feedback |
| ❌ | Put "Fixes: #16094" in the last commit: commit messages are unchanged |
| ❌ | Put "Fixes" after the description, not before: the PR description still says "Fixes part of: #16094" above the testing section |
| ❌ | Precise before/after screenshots: the description still shows the same wide screenshots, with a lot of unchanged UI |
| ℹ️ | There was one new push, but the size (+27/-31) and files are the same, so it likely did not address this feedback. CI status is unknown. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and tell the author which requests are still open.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! I don't see the changes yet: the commit messages still need the "Fixes a part of" lines removed and "Fixes: #16094" added to the last commit (see the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/version-control.html#commit-messages)). The screenshots also still need to be cropped to just the changed text, per the [guide on precise before/after screenshots](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
